summary: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held July 2, 2026. All proposals were approved except Proposal 3 (amended and restated compensation policy), which the Compensation Committee and Board will review for next steps. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private) is disclosed. This is a routine post-meeting report; it maps to a U.S. 8-K Item 5.07 disclosure. The filing triggers no risk-arb angle or structural note.
